name: Martyred Soul (Lathspell Archetype)
body:
Required Alignment: Any good.

Spellcasting

A martyred soul casts divine spells drawn from the paladin spell list instead of the normal lathspell spell list.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A martyred soul is proficient in all simple and martial weapons as well as all armors and shields, including tower shields.

This replaces the lathspell’s normal proficiencies as well as the armored casting abilities gained at 6th and 11th level.

Skills

A martyred soul adds Knowledge (Religion) to their class skills.

Martyr’s Spirit (Su)

A martyred soul does not gain the normal lathspell’s curse and instead gains a holy gift that manifests at 1st level as wounds, scars, tattoos, or other markings that match with the mythos or history of a religion or martyr of the faith from which the lathspell draws power.

At 2nd level, the martyred soul gain the ability to lay on hands to heal the wounds of others. A number of times per day equal to 3 + their Charisma modifier they may touch a creature as a standard action and restore 1d6 hit points plus an additional 1d6 per 2 levels after 1st to a maximum of 10d6 at level 19. When the martyred soul heals another creature in this way they take damage equal to the minimum amount of hit points they would restore plus their Charisma modifier. If the martyred soul uses this ability to restore their own hit points you may do so as a swift action but they only restore half as many hit points. This ability is considered lay on hands for the purposes of meeting prerequisites as well as any feats or special abilities that refer to lay on hands.

At 6th level, you gain a mercy as a paladin, using your lathspell level as your paladin level. Whenever you use a mercy, you must also take 3 damage. You gain an additional mercy at 10th, 14th, and 18th level.

At 10th level, whenever you take damage by using your lay on hands ability you gain a +2 morale bonus to attack and damage rolls and to your caster level for 1 minute. At 13th level and again at 16th and 19th level these bonuses improve by +1.

At 16th level, whenever an ally within 30 feet of you takes damage you may expend a use of lay on hands as an immediate action to take that damage instead, suffering all effects of the attack which causes the damage. For example, if an ally were targeted by disintegrate, you could instead take the damage for them, making a Fortitude save as per the spell, and your ally would be unaffected by it.

Martyr’s spirit replaces the lathspell’s curse, its manifestation, and all curse abilities they would normally gain.

Unyielding Defender (Ex)

At 8th level a martyred soul gains Bodyguard and In Harm’s Way as bonus feats without needing to meet the prerequisites.

This ability replaces cursed strike.

Zealous Rousing (Su)

At 12th level, you can be a beacon to guide your allies through any hardship.

As a standard action, you allow each ally within 30 feet to immediately receive a saving throw against any ongoing conditions currently affecting them, other than spells and effects which originated from their allies. This saving throw is in addition to any other saving throws normally granted by the ongoing effect, and success ends the condition.

This saving throw is made with a +2 bonus, using the same DC as the original effect. For each success rolled on these new saving throws you take 10 damage; if you take at least 30 damage in this way you gain DR 10/ and gain 15 energy resistance which applies to all energy types for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier. At the end of this duration you become fatigued. If you are already fatigued you instead become exhausted.

You cannot use this ability if you are already exhausted

This ability replaces penetrating curse.

Living Saint (Su)

At 20th level, your blessing and your body become one. Your type changes to outsider (native) and you cease aging. You gain DR 10/(alignment), overcome by an alignment subtype of your choice which does not match any of your alignment components. You gain energy resistance 10 to two energy types of your choice and immunity to a third. Finally, if you are slain while defending another’s life, you are brought back from the dead as per true resurrection 7 days later in a safe place within one mile of where you were slain.

This ability replaces walking curse.
